
```{r get_db_credentials, include=FALSE}
# Get database credentials from environment variables
dsn_database <- Sys.getenv("DB_NAME")
dsn_hostname <- Sys.getenv("DB_HOST")
dsn_port <- Sys.getenv("DB_PORT")
dsn_uid <- Sys.getenv("DB_USER")
dsn_pwd <- Sys.getenv("DB_PASSWORD")
```

```{r connect_db, include=FALSE}
# Connect to the PostgreSQL database
tryCatch(
  {
    conn <- dbConnect(
      RPostgres::Postgres(),
      dbname = dsn_database,
      host = dsn_hostname,
      port = dsn_port,
      user = dsn_uid,
      password = dsn_pwd
    )
    cat("Connected successfully!\n")
  },
  error = function(e) {
    cat("Error: ", e$message, "\n")
  }
)
```

## Session Details

```{r query_session_details, include=FALSE}
# Query the database to get detailed session information
session_details <- dbGetQuery(conn, paste0("
  SELECT
    session_id,
    created_at,
    subject_name,
    reinforcement_ratio,
    warning_hits,
    punishment_duration,
    feed_time,
    total_reinforcements,
    consecutive_warnings_limit,
    warning_alarm_volume,
    warning_display_volume,
    mode_name,
    sessions.mode_id,
    is_spot_on,
    punishment_periodicity,
    warning_duration,
    time_before_warning_signal,
    highlight_warning_signal,
    button_size,
    grace_radius,
    warning_signal_position,
    button_height,
    peck_slide,
    window_height,
    window_width,
    comments
  FROM sessions
  JOIN subjects ON sessions.subject_id = subjects.subject_id
  JOIN experiment_modes ON sessions.mode_id = experiment_modes.mode_id
  WHERE session_id = '", session_id, "';"))
```

```{r set_run_pecks_analysis, include=FALSE}
# Set the run_pecks_analysis parameter based on mode_id
if (session_details$mode_id == 1) {
  run_pecks_analysis <- FALSE
} else {
  run_pecks_analysis <- TRUE
}
```

## Session Results

```{r query_session_results, include=FALSE}
# Query the database to get detailed session information
session_results <- dbGetQuery(conn, paste0("
SELECT warning_quarter,
       COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
       SUM(CASE
               WHEN warning_terminated THEN 1
               ELSE 0
           END) AS terminations,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE
                     WHEN warning_terminated THEN 1
                     ELSE 0
                 END)::numeric / COUNT(*) * 100, 2) AS termination_percentage
FROM round_results rr
JOIN rounds r ON rr.round_id = r.round_id
WHERE r.session_id = '", session_id, "'
GROUP BY warning_quarter
ORDER BY warning_quarter;"))
```

```{r session_results_table, echo=FALSE}
# Set custom column headings
colnames(session_results) <- c("Warning Quarter", "Rounds", "Terminations", "Percentage")

# Transpose the session_details table for better readability
kable(session_results, caption = "Session Results") %>%
  kable_styling(font_size = 10) %>% # Adjust the font size as needed
  column_spec(2:ncol(session_results), width = "5em") # Adjust the width as needed
```

```{r query_session_results_history, include=FALSE}
# Query the database to get detailed session information
session_results_history <- dbGetQuery(conn, paste0("
WITH session_info AS (
    SELECT
        subject_id,
        reinforcement_ratio,
        mode_id
    FROM
        sessions
    WHERE
        session_id = '", session_id, "'
),
termination_data AS (
    SELECT
        sr.session_id,
        sr.warning_quarter,
        sr.terminations,
        sr.total_rounds,
        sr.result_time
    FROM
        session_results sr
    JOIN
        sessions s ON sr.session_id = s.session_id
    WHERE
        s.subject_id = (SELECT subject_id FROM session_info) AND
        s.mode_id = (SELECT mode_id FROM session_info)
        AND s.reinforcement_ratio = (SELECT reinforcement_ratio FROM session_info)
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY result_time) AS session_index,
    TO_CHAR(result_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS result_time,
    MAX(CASE WHEN warning_quarter = 1 THEN terminations ELSE 0 END) AS quarter_1_terminations,
    MAX(CASE WHEN warning_quarter = 1 THEN total_rounds ELSE 0 END) AS quarter_1_total_rounds,
    MAX(CASE WHEN warning_quarter = 2 THEN terminations ELSE 0 END) AS quarter_2_terminations,
    MAX(CASE WHEN warning_quarter = 2 THEN total_rounds ELSE 0 END) AS quarter_2_total_rounds,
    MAX(CASE WHEN warning_quarter = 3 THEN terminations ELSE 0 END) AS quarter_3_terminations,
    MAX(CASE WHEN warning_quarter = 3 THEN total_rounds ELSE 0 END) AS quarter_3_total_rounds,
    MAX(CASE WHEN warning_quarter = 4 THEN terminations ELSE 0 END) AS quarter_4_terminations,
    MAX(CASE WHEN warning_quarter = 4 THEN total_rounds ELSE 0 END) AS quarter_4_total_rounds
FROM
    termination_data
GROUP BY
    result_time
ORDER BY
    result_time DESC;"))

# Step 1: Convert List Columns to Numeric
columns_to_convert <- c(
  "quarter_1_terminations", "quarter_1_total_rounds",
  "quarter_2_terminations", "quarter_2_total_rounds",
  "quarter_3_terminations", "quarter_3_total_rounds",
  "quarter_4_terminations", "quarter_4_total_rounds"
)

# Convert relevant columns to numeric
session_results_history[columns_to_convert] <- lapply(session_results_history[columns_to_convert], function(col) {
  as.numeric(unlist(col))
})


# Step 2.1: Calculate Percentage Columns
session_results_history$quarter_1_percentage <- ifelse(
  session_results_history$quarter_1_total_rounds > 0,
  (session_results_history$quarter_1_terminations / session_results_history$quarter_1_total_rounds) * 100,
  0
)

session_results_history$quarter_2_percentage <- ifelse(
  session_results_history$quarter_2_total_rounds > 0,
  (session_results_history$quarter_2_terminations / session_results_history$quarter_2_total_rounds) * 100,
  0
)

session_results_history$quarter_3_percentage <- ifelse(
  session_results_history$quarter_3_total_rounds > 0,
  (session_results_history$quarter_3_terminations / session_results_history$quarter_3_total_rounds) * 100,
  0
)

session_results_history$quarter_4_percentage <- ifelse(
  session_results_history$quarter_4_total_rounds > 0,
  (session_results_history$quarter_4_terminations / session_results_history$quarter_4_total_rounds) * 100,
  0
)

# Step 2.2: Create Formatted Columns

session_results_history_latest <- head(session_results_history, 5)


calculate_formatted_column <- function(terminations, total_rounds, percentage) {
  sprintf("%d / %d (%.2f%%)", terminations, total_rounds, percentage)
}

session_results_history_latest$quarter_1 <- mapply(
  calculate_formatted_column,
  session_results_history_latest$quarter_1_terminations,
  session_results_history_latest$quarter_1_total_rounds,
  session_results_history_latest$quarter_1_percentage
)

session_results_history_latest$quarter_2 <- mapply(
  calculate_formatted_column,
  session_results_history_latest$quarter_2_terminations,
  session_results_history_latest$quarter_2_total_rounds,
  session_results_history_latest$quarter_2_percentage
)

session_results_history_latest$quarter_3 <- mapply(
  calculate_formatted_column,
  session_results_history_latest$quarter_3_terminations,
  session_results_history_latest$quarter_3_total_rounds,
  session_results_history_latest$quarter_3_percentage
)

session_results_history_latest$quarter_4 <- mapply(
  calculate_formatted_column,
  session_results_history_latest$quarter_4_terminations,
  session_results_history_latest$quarter_4_total_rounds,
  session_results_history_latest$quarter_4_percentage
)

# Step 3: Prepare the Final Table
session_results_history_latest <- session_results_history_latest[, c(
  "session_index", "result_time",
  "quarter_1", "quarter_2",
  "quarter_3", "quarter_4"
)]
```

```{r session_results_history_latest_table, echo=FALSE}

# Transpose the session_details table for better readability
kable(session_results_history_latest, caption = "Session History (Last 5 Sessions)") %>%
  kable_styling(font_size = 10) # Adjust the font size as needed
# kable_styling(font_size = 10) %>%  # Adjust the font size as needed
# column_spec(2:ncol(session_results_history_latest), width = "5em") # Adjust the width as needed
```

## Warning Termination Percentage by Quarter

```{r session_results_history_line_chart, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
# Load necessary libraries
library(tidyr) # Ensure tidyr is loaded for pivot_longer
library(ggplot2) # Ensure ggplot2 is loaded
library(kableExtra) # Ensure kableExtra is loaded

# Convert integer64 columns to numeric before plotting
session_results_history$session_index <- as.numeric(session_results_history$session_index)

# Extract percentages for each quarter
completion_table <- session_results_history[, c("session_index", "quarter_1_percentage", "quarter_2_percentage", "quarter_3_percentage", "quarter_4_percentage")]

# Transform the table into long format for the line graph
completion_table_long <- pivot_longer(completion_table,
  cols = starts_with("quarter_"),
  names_to = "Quarter",
  values_to = "Completion_Percentage",
  names_prefix = "quarter_"
)

# Convert quarter identifiers to readable format (optional)
completion_table_long$Quarter <- gsub("_percentage", "", completion_table_long$Quarter)
completion_table_long$Quarter <- paste("Quarter", completion_table_long$Quarter)

# Create the line graph
ggplot(completion_table_long, aes(x = session_index, y = Completion_Percentage, color = Quarter, shape = Quarter)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 3, fill = "white") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(1, 2, 0, 5)) + # Use 1 for circle, 2 for triangle, 0 for square, 5 for kite
  labs(
    title = "Completion Percentage by Quarter",
    x = "Session",
    y = "Completion Percentage (%)",
    color = "Quarter",
    shape = "Quarter"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) + # Set y-axis span from 0 to 100
  theme_minimal()
```

## Pecks Distribution

```{r pecks, include=FALSE, eval=run_pecks_analysis}
# Query the database to get detailed session information

pecks <- dbGetQuery(conn, paste0("
WITH last_session AS (
    SELECT session_id
    FROM rounds
    ORDER BY started_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT p.*
FROM pecks p
JOIN rounds r ON p.round_id = r.round_id
WHERE r.session_id = '", session_id, "';"))
```

```{r pecks_scatterplot, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=8, eval=run_pecks_analysis}
# Create a scatterplot to show the position of the pecks using base R

window_width <- session_details$window_width[1]
window_height <- session_details$window_height[1]
button_size <- session_details$button_size[1]
button_height <- session_details$button_height[1]
warning_signal_position <- session_details$warning_signal_position[1]

plot(pecks$x_pos * window_width, pecks$y_pos * window_height,
  xlab = "X Position", ylab = "Y Position",
  main = "Pecks Distribution",
  xlim = c(0, window_width), ylim = c(0, window_height),
  pch = 19, col = "blue", cex = 0.1
) # Adjust the cex parameter to make the dots smaller

# Add circles
symbols((0.3 + (warning_signal_position / 100.0) * 0.4) * window_width, button_height / 100.0 * window_height, circles = button_size / 100.0 / 2.0 * window_height, add = TRUE, inches = FALSE, fg = "red")
symbols(0.7 * window_width, button_height / 100.0 * window_height, circles = button_size / 100.0 / 2.0 * window_height, add = TRUE, inches = FALSE, fg = "green")

# Add additional circles with grace radius if it exists
if (!is.null(session_details$grace_radius)) {
  grace_radius <- session_details$grace_radius * 1080
  symbols((0.3 + (warning_signal_position / 100.0) * 0.4) * window_width, button_height / 100.0 * window_height, circles = button_size / 100.0 / 2.0 * window_height + grace_radius / 100.0, add = TRUE, inches = FALSE, fg = "red", lty = 2)
  symbols(0.7 * window_width, button_height / 100.0 * window_height, circles = button_size / 100.0 / 2.0 * window_height + grace_radius / 100.0, add = TRUE, inches = FALSE, fg = "green", lty = 2)
}
```
